shrines.label: Tiruvaali
shrines.sthalaPuranam:
At Tiruvaali, we can see Lakshmi Narasimhar. It is said that after killing Hiranyakashipu,

the Lord was still furious. To get the Lord to calm down all the devas, Lord Brahma and

Lord Shiva asked Mahalakshmi to isolate the Lord to a different location. Thus, the Lord

was taken to Tiruvaali. Usually, we see that Lakshmi is seated on the Lord’s left lap, but

here, we can see Lakshmi seated on the Lord’s right, allowing her to hug and embrace the

Lord. Thus, the place got its name Tiruvaali(Tiru meaning Lakshmi and Aali meaning

Aalinganam or hug in Sanskrit).

sthalaPuranam:
*** Vedupari Utsavam

Tiruvaali is said to be the birthplace of Amritavalli Thayaar, and Tirunagari is said to be the

birthplace of Lord Vayalali Manavalan. It is said that on the night that the Lord got married

to Thayaar, they were targeted and looted by TirumangaiAzhwar. Before becoming a saint,

TirumangaiAzhwar was a dacoit named Kaliyan.

TirumangaiAzhwar wanted to marry a woman named Kumudhavalli. She placed two

conditions, namely, 1) To get Pancha-Samskaram done, and 2) to perform

tadhiyararadhanam (annadhanam) for a thousand people for one year. To satisfy the

second condition, TirumangaiAzhwar used to steal gold from anyone he could find, sell the

gold to get money to serve people. As fate would have it, TirumangaiAzhwar ran into the

Lord and Thayaar. He pulled out a knife and told them to remove all the jewelry that they

were wearing. The Lord and Thayaar gave up all their jewelry. TirumangaiAzhwar tied up

all of the jewelry in a cloth, and as he was about to lift it, the Lord performed an

enchantment in such a way that he could no longer lift it. In anger, TirumangaiAzhwar



threatened the Lord to give him the mantra that would allow him to lift the bag. The Lord

smiled and told him that he was performing all of this to make sure that TirumangaiAzhwar

would obtain this mantra and propagate it to the world. Thus the Lord gave

TirumangaiAzhwar the ashtakshara mantram. All of this is performed as a drama to date on

Panguni Uttaram day. Find the pictures of the utsavam attached below.





35) Tirudevanaar Togai
